description:
The natural persons in office at one French company (at most five) and, for each, their OTHER companies
the official gazette placed in safeguard, receivership or liquidation: name, SIREN, procedure, date.
Answers "have the directors of X run companies that failed". No birth date, no personal sanction.

siren.description: Nine-digit SIREN, spaces and dots accepted. A SIRET minus its last five digits.

name: get_french_company_officers_insolvencies
title: Officers of a French company and insolvencies of their other companies
